cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I'll make your coffee. I know this machine: this button starts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. The coffee button is behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Naturally. Steam first, then the concealed coffee controls. Where's your cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here. It makes two cups unless you turn that dial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Dial to one. I always tailor the standard procedure to the guest.

mechanism: A copies a confident model incorrectly, then learns each practical step while treating the new clue as familiar procedure.
confusable: Unlike simply suppressing questions, D42 learns from clues; S04 specifically copies confidence without admitting confusion.
comparison: Coffee service for a guest versus joint shelter assembly before rain.
seedUse: Preserve the effective steam/flap/dial and tent-component clues; supply an actual copied model.
